direction.name: 행동의 연속과 중앙 문장
direction.organization: A horizontal sequence of three tightly edited real repair moments runs across the upper half. The lower region is a strongly connected invitation with two substantial description lines then aligned event and participation groups; a modest title bridges the sequence and body rather than a giant title at one end.
direction.concept: People share tools: fastening a chair joint, sewing a garment and handing a restored useful thing to a neighbor. Cropped real hands and worn objects express cooperation, not a decorative hero object.
direction.image_grammar: Documentary color photographs with crisp contact geometry and close crop, three different scales tied by the direction of hands. Restrained cobalt/brick accents from actual tools and fabric, daylight skin/wood. The image sequence and its crop dominate the overall structure.
direction.body_flow: The middle handoff invites the central title, then the full meaning paragraph below, then adjacent event/date/time/place and fee/deadline/item/URL blocks aligned with that paragraph. Choose substantial mature body at a 720px viewing assumption, reserve its actual sentence area first. Reading does not jump to remote corners.
direction.type: Dense but precise editorial Korean sans body, mature compact counters and robust medium strokes, Latin optically matched. Title can be a moderate serif; body remains upright clean print.
direction.distinctness: Across-the-width multiple photo moments with copy beneath their seam; no giant left object and right information, no surrounding collage or center narrative ink path.
